name: flow_loading_start_without
description: Loading a party's match (design 6.6): Ben's game is stuck at 30%. From 15 s his card reads Slow and the line waits for him; from 30 s, with my seat loaded, I lead, so my loading screen offers Start without Ben beside Leave. It sends PARTY start; the server (the fake sequencer) starts the seats loaded, and Ben's seat begins AWAY in turn 0, where the caretaker plays it. Before 30 s there is no such button.

steps.msg: at 20 s there is only Leave

steps.assert: Session.is_leader() and Session.state_name() == 'LOADING' and node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').card_lines()[1].begins_with('Ben Lamplighter Slow')
steps.msg: I lead; Ben's card reads Slow at 31 s

steps.assert: Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('StartWithout', true, false).visible and Session.get_node('LoadingScreen').find_child('StartWithout', true, false).text == 'Start without Ben'
steps.msg: from 30 s the leader gets Start without Ben
PARTY start while loading: the match started without Ben, AWAY in turn 0
the caretaker plays Ben's seat (AWAY) until he comes
